skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the economic nature of trade
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand and apply foundational knowledge about the field of trade within the national economy.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing the development of trade in Vietnam
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to analyze the current state of trade development in Vietnam across different periods and in the context of international trade integration.
Students will understand and apply foundational knowledge about organizing trade activities in the national economy.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Proposing solutions for macro trade issues
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will use specialized knowledge about trade to propose directions and solutions for macro trade issues in Vietnam.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Effective organization and management of trade business
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will use specialized knowledge about trading goods and services to effectively organize and manage trade business at enterprises.
Students will develop teamwork, management, and leadership skills to effectively implement trade activities in an international environment.
Students will demonstrate independence when working alone and take responsibility for their individual and group work.
Students will fulfill social responsibilities and professional ethics when making judgments and decisions on professional issues and trade business operations.
